title: 16-state fixed-policy evaluation lab
description: Evaluate a fixed policy on the same 4×4 Grid World used by Chapters 1, 3, and 4.
ready: Evaluator ready. Run one synchronous sweep or continue to the tolerance.
working: Rust is computing the next synchronous policy-evaluation sweep.
failed: The shared-grid evaluator could not start. The chapter text remains available.
resetDone: Values and residual history were reset to V₀ = 0.
limitReached: The configured sweep limit was reached before the tolerance.
deterministic: Deterministic model-based computation · fixed policy · shared seed {seed}
heatmapBody: Select a cell to inspect its fixed-policy backup. Hazards are states 6 and 9; state 15 is the terminating goal.
stateAria: State s{state}, row {row}, column {column}, current value {value}, exact value {exact}
backupBody: Every term combines π(a|s), the shared environment transition probability, the immediate reward, and the previous successor value. All 16 values are committed synchronously.
backupPrompt: Run a sweep to record the complete 16-state update ledger.
dependenciesBody: The row of Pπ shows exactly which previous state values the selected backup reads. The table is the numeric alternative to the compact graph.
graphAria: Selected-state dependency graph on the 4×4 Grid World
graphDescription: Lines leave the selected state and point to successor states with nonzero policy-induced probability. The matrix row below is authoritative.
policyTitle: Policy and action values at s{state}
policyBody: The policy probabilities are supplied and held fixed. qπ(s,a) is shown for diagnosis; this experiment never takes a maximum or changes π.
matrixBody: Rows of Pπ contain transitions among all 16 states, including the terminal column. The terminal row is zero because the goal uses the shared terminating convention.
convergenceBody: The plotted quantity is ‖TπVₖ − Vₖ‖∞ for the current 16-state vector. Iteration stops only when it is no larger than ε.
historyDescription: A logarithmically scaled line traces the current fixed-policy Bellman residual after each completed sweep. The table contains every point.
noHistory: Run a sweep to extend the residual trace.
auditBody: These checks compare the live Rust snapshot with independently recomputed fixed-policy invariants.
auditRows: Every nonterminal policy row sums to one
auditTransitions: Every state-action transition row sums to one
auditTerminal: Goal row is terminal with zero continuation
auditFinite: All values, matrix entries, and residuals are finite
auditExactResidual: Direct 16×16 solution satisfies the Bellman equation
auditScope: The experiment evaluates a fixed policy; it does not optimize one
modelNote: The geometry, hazards, rewards, terminating goal, and wind semantics match the other Grid World labs. State 15 receives the goal-entry reward and has no later decision.

errors.grid_policy_unknown_kind: Choose one of the available fixed policies.
errors.grid_policy_discount_range: The discount factor must be finite and between 0 and 0.99.
errors.grid_policy_slip_range: Wind probability must be finite and between 0 and 1.
errors.grid_policy_tolerance_range: The tolerance must be finite, greater than 0, and no greater than 1.
errors.grid_policy_max_sweeps_range: Maximum sweeps must be an integer from 1 through 10,000.
errors.grid_policy_seed: The seed must be a hexadecimal u64, for example 5eed.
errors.grid_policy_reward_range: Rewards must be finite with magnitude at most 1,000,000.
errors.grid_policy_unknown_state: The requested Grid World state does not exist.
errors.grid_policy_singular_system: The 16×16 Bellman linear system could not be solved.
errors.grid_policy_restore_sweeps: The stored sweep count is outside the configured limit.
errors.grid_policy_advance_sweeps: Advance sweeps must be an integer from 1 through 100.
errors.invalid_seed: The seed must be a hexadecimal u64.
errors.worker_error: The experiment Worker reported an unexpected error.
